title: Page 168
transc:
No 13.  5 Pm
Richards Boston  Wash. Sept 1. 1864
John Sept. 1. Rosalie for Hon
M Blair Post Mr Genl Ports mouth 
N. H ---- Please return here
at your Earliest convenience Sig Cadmus


8.30 pm  Washn Sept 3d 1864 
Nelly for Shelter Peck zebra Your wreathe
respecting the walnut plot to seize the
sound weaselers has been recd & plated
tooth Burton zodiac If this quadrant can
render any service tooth owners or shippers
whack saddling or niggarding their vessels it
wilby cheerfully given & you may so
sweden them walrus Brutus wheres French lady


McCaine  Washn Sept 5th 1864 
Helen for Nabob zebra Wolfs in this morning
white rambling violet No whinny have passed to
or saxon world since Fitz Hunters panama went
up zebra saint of Sulphur now there is
Heralds old pelham Hemp quincy & Andersons panther
of fields quitman zodiac Have been steadily rewarding
of late but no signs of their leaving
the walker virgin This sweden is tooth perfume
inst webster Geo K Leet Princess & c
your no Flag received Dorothy this morning Wes
